controls: k=0,1,r-1,floor(r/2) through solver path on48 domains; fixed offcurve (0,0) if b!=0 else(0,1), canonical-range/badr/domain negatives, toy y0 branch; mutation k+1modr rejected for same valid Q.

entrypoints.driver.py: Fresh subprocess A/B, identical cohort/order, independent source/input hashes, stop/reap descendants, resource cap bookkeeping only, canonical certificate content hashes excluding timestamps, seal before verify opens candidate raw.
entrypoints.solver.py: Public-only canonical scalar-certificate search using new affine Euclid arithmetic and HAC BSGS; no candidate imports/scalar labels; input schema/IDs/curve params once, sorted minimal JSON certificates.
entrypoints.verify.py: Own independent arithmetic, all48 domains and1536 original equations, positives/negative/mutation controls, A/A identity, then strict posthoc R52 joins/equations for every RECOVERED field. No producer arithmetic imports; no expected historical valid/distinct count prewritten.

excluded: No old candidate/sampler/generator/baseline launch, no group-operation/field-operation/performance/timing metrics, no new nonce/cohort, no speedup/S/GAE/p^(1/3), no oldformatrepair. No unit/control/solver execution in this source-only task.
native_solution_manifest: Driver must carry actual finite discrete_log certificate for successful reference solves and directly verify the claimed public equation before setting verified:true; independent verify.py checks all equations again. Do not set attack_claimed:false to deny actual finite discrete-log outputs. Excluded claims are novelty/performance/exponent/security extrapolation, not the finite solution itself.
output_interface: Declare no more than12 native JSON artifacts; certificates-A.json/B.json complete1536 rows (compact percurve vectors permitted), input/group parameters once, canonical payload digest excludes operational timestamps. Literal tools/artifacts/artifacts.py DATA_EXT excludes .json: default any noncode>1048576 bytes goes to store; only listed DATA_EXT or .part>65536 bytes also does. No keep override covers this harness. JSON<=1MiB can stayGit under defaultpolicy. Supervisor experiment_execution.py compacts after checker; bind logical content SHA and wire representation in native receipts/metadata, no private publisher/symlinks or silent postseal raw rewrite.
required_before_scientific_approval: Exact source+input+commands published; complete native frozen protocol/spec/trialplan/queue/executor+archive coverage; approvable:true; standing approvalDEC/archive/push; native execution_state ready, claim and checkpointgate. Source-only approval is not experiment approval.
table_and_control_schedule: Each fresh pass A/B builds one table on EACH of all48 domains for known-scalar controls {0,1,r-1,floor(r/2)}. Reuse that same table for the64 public targets on each of24 target-bearing domains; retain controls for24 domains whose public target list is empty. No separate table percontrol and no skipped control domains. Repeat all controls/tables in fresh passB; compare canonical public1536 certificates and control validity. Table/control work is included actual witness search, never a performance metric.
